longDescription:
GrimRipper is a graphical Audio CD ripper. It fetches CD metadatas from online databases and compresses the tracks.

Supported codecs: WAV, MP3, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC, Opus, Wavpack, Musepack, AAC, and Monkey's audio files.

Features:

  • Uses CDDB to name and tag each track.
  • Creates M3U playlists
  • Can encode to multiple formats in one session
  • Simultaneous rip and encode
  • Does not require a specific desktop environment
